name: Default
shortDescription: Dev data platform that collects data from GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Jenkins and other DevOps tools and shows DORA and engineering metrics in bundled Grafana dashboards.

alerts.message: The config UI asks for HTTP basic auth: sign in as ADMIN_USER with the generated ADMIN_PASS. On the first visit it shows a database migration page: click Proceed to Database Migration to create the tables. The Grafana dashboards under /grafana have their own login: admin with the generated GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD, which only applies on the first start.
